name: Cliff suite (template)

frame.axes: x east, y north, z up; metres

purpose: A private room carved into the north cliff: tatami and washi inside, a stone tub on the cliff edge fed by the trickle from the suite above, the sea and the night below.

ceiling_profile.note: Timber ceiling 3.2 m in the tatami room; 2.6 m in the genkan; the rock overhang above the tub niche and veranda reaches 3.0 m.

balcony_local: from layout: [[0,12],[18,12],[18,16],[0,16]] for columns a and b (bridging the gully), [[0,12],[16,12],[16,16],[0,16]] for c

zones.note: Entry vestibule with storage (32 plan); door from the veranda at (1.5, 12).
Futon, tea table, tokonoma on the back (south) wall; shoji front at y 11.8.
Rock niche open to the north under the overhang.

zones.area: balcony band y 14.3-16 over the full balcony length
zones.note: Public balcony walk (centre y 15.15 = layout 109.15) linking suites and the Cliff Stair; low hinoki fence + sudare at y 14.25. Columns a/b: crosses the gully (x 16-18) with a 0.6 m bronze-grated slot at x 16.7-17.3 that the trickle falls through.

portals_note: Walk portals are absolute, per suite file (from layout.json); only the private openings are local.

portals_local.note: Gate in the fence to the private veranda.

hero.why: A natural basalt tub sunk flush in the floor at the cliff edge under the rock overhang, glowing teal, the trickle from the suite above pouring in from a bamboo spout (21, 32 plan): framed through the open shoji from the futon.
hero.note: Stone kerb 0.25 m proud of the floor (water 0.2 m above floor would read as flush from eye height); fully flush hides the glow.

anchored.why: Low futon facing the shoji and the view.
Scroll and ikebana on the back wall (21).
Bamboo spout from the east gully (x local 16-18, the 2 m gap between suites) into the tub.
Hinoki bucket and towel at the tub (21).
Closed washi bay west of the opening, lit from inside.
Closed bay east of the opening, beside the tub niche.
Back screen line: the tatami room is 9 x 8 m, the south strip is the quiet tokonoma and storage side.
Screen between genkan and room (door gap at y 9-12).

water.note: Sunken tub, rim flush with the floor. Inflow: kakehi from the gully at x local 16-20; overflow back into the gully.

water.outside_ok: Gully in the 2 m cliff gap east of each suite (x local 16-18).
water.note: Trickle column falling past this tier; on columns a/b it passes through the grated slot in the balcony walk, on c it falls clear beside the dead end.

sightlines.see: Across the tatami to the tub glowing teal in its niche.
Through the open shoji: night sea and the sky beyond the balcony rail.
The trickle falling past in the gully, lit from the tub below.

concept.match: 21: from inside the tatami room, futon on the left, open shoji bays, the glowing tub under the overhang with the spout pouring in, night sea beyond the rail.

lights.why: Two andon at the futon head, one at the tokonoma: a warm pool by the bed, darker elsewhere.
Ankle light at the tub niche.
Tub glows teal: the brightest thing in the suite.
Posts are the balcony rail's own posts (the 1.7 m walk band leaves no room inboard).

dressing.why: Privacy fence between walk and veranda; the gate gap is x local 0-2.1.
Potted pine inside the gate, off the walk.

mood.key: teal tub under rock, warm room
mood.palette: tatami gold, washi cream, warm andon, teal tub, black wet rock

waivers.reason: The continuous safety rail along the balcony edge (y 109.85) passes the 20 m cell centres at (150/170/190, 110); a rail cannot step round a grid point.
